answer_1.quote: Text Simplification (TS) can be regarded as a natural language generation task ... the generated text has a reduced language complexity ... while preserving its original information and meaning.

answer_2.quote: We use automatic evaluation metrics widely used in text simplification task. SARI ... BLEU ... FKGL ... We compute SARI, BLEU, and FKGL using EASSE.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation on the outputs of different systems ... we run our evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk by asking five workers to rate using 5-point likert scale on three aspects: (1) Fluency (or Grammaticality), (2) Simplicity, (3) Adequacy (or Meaning preservation).
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated sentence on a 5‑point Likert scale for Fluency, Simplicity, and Adequacy.
